channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: California got new tech regulations — barely: 2025 in review
item.description: California showed it was serious about regulating Big Tech in 2025 — and Big Tech showed it was serious about fighting regulations.

item.title: Go behind the headlines with Times of San Diego staff as they share their most memorable 2025 stories
item.description: We asked Times of San Diego staffers and contributors to reflect on the year's work and share some of their 2025 favorites with you.

item.title: San Diego Public Library to hold Winter Reading Challenge through January
item.description: To kick off the challenge, a celebration event will take place from 10:30 a.m. to noon Saturday at Pacific Highlands Ranch Library.

item.title: Power outage reported in La Mesa
item.description: The power was out for a total of 117 customers in La Mesa on Tuesday morning during an outage that began at 8:30 a.m.

item.title: Opinion: Californians’ view of insurance must shift from piggy bank to safety net
item.description: The healthiest insurance market is boring: well-designed policies, priced fairly, rarely used, quietly standing by in case of a life-altering event.

item.title: Victim in crash into Bay Park house had restraining order against husband now accused of her murder
item.description: Monica Coates was found dead inside the master bathroom with "severe injuries" consistent with having been burned, police said.

item.title: San Diego transit agencies offer free rides, extended hours on New Year’s Eve
item.description: Beginning at 6 p.m. on Wednesday and continuing into the early morning hours, rides will be free on buses, trolleys and trains with additional service.

item.title: ‘I forgive you,’ man tells deputy moments after drawing knife, being shot near IB Pier
item.description: Body-cam video released Tuesday depicts an apparently suicidal homeless man's exchange with deputies in the moments leading to his death.

item.title: Several holiday beach destinations under water contact closures, advisories
item.description: Thinking about a swim at the beach before the year runs out? You may want to think again, as several water contact closures and advisories are in effect along the San Diego County coastline.

item.title: San Diego County sheriff seeks donations to outfit K-9s with bulletproof vests
item.description: San Diego County sheriff's officials are seeking donations to help equip all the agency's patrol dogs with bulletproof vests.
